title: Aerial: no house on the lot
detail: The 1924 aerial shows an unpaved road junction and open farmland character; no building on the lot.

title: 1940s tax photo shows a finished house
detail: A Municipal Archives tax photo (sign “4931 - 5 Q”) shows a finished brick house matching this one: arched door in a projecting gable, stone-textured surround, brick chimney toward the SE. This conflicts with the 1945 build year. The mirror’s automated placement may be wrong, so both claims are kept.

title: Earliest aerial with the house

title: 1980s tax photo of the NW gable end
detail: Yellow gable siding, white arched door with stone surround, silver chain-link fence around the front yard. The ground floor of the front gable reads grey and stone-textured, unlike today’s brick (unresolved).

title: Extension visible by 2004
detail: A pale segment at the SE end of the house matches the extension; a small dark roof at the SE rear is consistent with the garage (partly tree-covered). Both are certain by Aug 2012.

title: Single-storey SE extension
detail: Single-storey white extension at SE end of house present in every Street View set from Aug 2012 onward; PLUTO ext code EG records an extension but yearalter1/yearalter2 are 0
